mapper.update: update space set has_child = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select id as "key", space_name as "title", (case when has_child = '1' then 0 else 1 end) as isLeaf, pid as parentId from space where pid = #{pid}
and ${key} = #{value}
mapper.update: update space set full_name = concat(#{fullName},space_name),full_id = #{fullId} where full_id = #{oldFullId} or full_id like concat(#{oldFullId},"-%")
